observation: The captured 3072 bytes are all zero, but the capture was made at physical_total_bytes - 0xE0000. The LBA7 type4 pointer is CHS_bytes - 0xE0000, 10440 sectors earlier. The actual Region A bytes of this disk were not captured in this snapshot.
proves: The old all-zero file cannot be used to claim that no-password disks have an all-zero Region A.
This two-entry LBA7 profile points type4 to the CHS-based Region A while type2 points to LBA63; the two entries are not universally co-located.
limitations: The actual Region A contents and business role on this SanDisk disk remain unknown.
The historical decoded LBA7 file was used as a read-only field cross-check; this audit did not recapture the device.
